# Leave and Travel Policy

This synthetic policy describes leave requests and business travel.

## Leave Requests

Employees should submit a request before making travel or coverage commitments.

### Required information

1. Select the leave category.
   - Annual leave
   - Personal leave
   - Medical leave
2. Enter the requested dates.
   - Include partial days when applicable.
   - Exclude public holidays.
3. Identify a backup contact.

| Leave category | Annual allowance | Approval route |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Annual | 20 days | Manager |
| Personal | 5 days | Manager |
| Medical | 10 days | Manager and People Operations |

> Approval confirms scheduling only. It does not change the employee's recorded allowance.

## Business Travel

### Before booking

- Obtain written approval.
- Compare at least two reasonable travel options.
- Use the approved booking channel.

### Reimbursement

Receipts should be submitted within ten working days after returning.

| Expense | Receipt required | Maximum without escalation |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| Hotel | Yes | 150 per night |
| Local transport | Yes | 75 per trip |
| Meals | Yes | 50 per day |

## Exceptions

Exceptions must include a business reason and an approving manager.
